description: This file handles importing requirements from Mantis XML issue reports into the TestLink project management system. It includes functions for file upload handling, parsing XML data, mapping issues to requirements, and integrating with the system's requirement management modules.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for requirement specifications, used to create requirements from parsed XML data.

classes.name: requirement_mgr
classes.description: Manager class for general requirement operations, including creating requirements from a map.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Tree structure class to handle requirement hierarchy traversal and info retrieval.

methods.name: templateConfiguration
methods.description: Returns configured template settings for Smarty templates.

methods.name: simplexml_load_file_wrapper
methods.description: Loads XML file with error handling; a wrapper around simplexml_load_file.

methods.name: getItemsFromSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts item data from the XML object for import.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Initializes localized labels for XML parsing.
